en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet village street with unpaved road and wooden utility poles. On the left is a two‑storey plastered house with a steep tiled roof, shuttered windows and a rectangular signboard on the wall; two women in early 20th‑century clothing walk in front of it. Farther down the curving street are several timber‑framed or wooden houses with multiple windows and gabled roofs. A couple of other figures stand near the middle distance. Trees and a long wall line the right side of the road. The overall scene suggests a small northern or central European town.
